d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Denmark vs Argentina in Group C of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Argentina and Denmark shared a 3-3 group stage draw at Aspire Zone in Doha after a Noah Madsen penalty and an Ekene Chukwuani strike put Denmark 2-0 up, Giovanni Baroni, Juan Cruz Policella and Alan Alcaraz turned it around with three second-half goals in ten minutes, and Omran Khatar equalised late on. Argentina finish second in Group C to reach the Round of 32, edging Mozambique on head-to-head, while Denmark exit the tournament.
